title: lazygit
description: See which of your git repos have changes to commit or commits to push or pull; click one to open lazygit in it, or pull or push in one click.
examples: The menu bar shows ⎇ 2: click it to see pilot with 3 changed files and agents with 2 commits to push, then Push
Type pil: pilot with its branch and changes; Return opens lazygit in it, Cmd+K Ghostty, Finder or its GitHub page

preferences.name: folder
preferences.title: Repos folder
preferences.description: Used only when Pilot does not send its own (Defaults › Folders › Repos). Repos up to three folders deep in it are listed; node_modules, build folders and hidden folders are skipped.
